_readme: Config for statusline.js / statusline-refresh.js (footer under the input box).
_segments: Footer line, pieces joined by '  ·  '. Any of: model, mode, cwd, git, cost, balance. Reorder or remove freely.
_prices: Model prices in CNY per 1M tokens. '_default' applies to models not listed. cache_hit = prompt cache read, cache_miss = uncached input, output = completion tokens.
